.@marceelias said this a YEAR ago. It was sound advice then-- and even better advice today. If we want to win the redistricting war, we need to start taking action. Looking at you, Democrats in NJ, NY, MD, CO, IL, WA, OR. Democracy is on the line. Wake up and start fighting back.

We "need to tell Republicans that if they take 5 seats, we're going to put 30 seats on the table... When people say to me 'don't bring a knife to a gunfight,' I don't even want to bring a gun to a gunfight. I want to b

Virginia is "a wakeup call to Democrats across the country - in NJ, NY, MD, IL, OR, WA, CO - this is the time to start fighting back... Republicans don't believe that Democrats have the right to exist as a party. If we don't start fighting back as a party, we're going to good government ourselves into obscurity."

h/t @Elex_Michaelson @CNNTheStoryIs

Video

Still true a year later 👇


Brian Tyler Cohen (@briantylercohen)

For all those rightwingers crying about how “DeMoCrAtS GerRyMaNdEr ToO,” just ask them if they support a nationwide ban on gerrymandering. We do. They don’t. They’re not mad at the concept of gerrymandering, they’re mad that they don’t get to be the only party wielding it anymore.



— https://nitter.net/briantylercohen/status/1952575997729235258#m

"I concede that when you have a gerrymandered map, certain people are disenfranchised... I didn't agree with it when it happened in Texas, but what I don't want to see is unilateral disarmament. I think gerrymandering is a scourge all around, but if you really care about disenfranchisement, you'd have cared about it when it happened in Texas."

h/t @Elex_Michaelson @CNNTheStoryIs
